title: The Effect of OMT on Functional Outcomes and Anti-inflammatory Biomarkers in Mild to Moderate Traumatic Brain Injury
brief_summary: Test the hypothesis that a certain set of osteopathic manipulation procedures preformed on patients with mild to moderate traumatic brain injury will result in accelerated rates of recovery assessed using vestibular function tests, quality of life questionnaires and measurements of the levels of anti-inflammatory metabolite and protein biomarkers in the blood and urine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of mild to moderate traumatic brain injury
* Chief complaint of headache and/or dizziness
* 18 years or older
* Medically stable/free from acute infection or fever
* Not a danger to self or others
* Not actively engaged in substance abuse
* Minimum Ranchos Los Amigos Level of 4 (http://www.traumaticbraininjury.com/symptoms-of-tbi/).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Minors below age of 18
* Any acute fracture or bleeding
* Head, neck or back wounds that would prevent OMT treatment
